contradictions.english: they shall enter into the king’s palace
contradictions.why: The source text (Psalm 45:16) refers to the palace of the king, but the English translation of the subsequent section (Psalm 46:5) incorrectly translates the Hebrew 'נהר' (river) as 'There is not a river', negating the existence of the river mentioned in the source.
